title: Repositories
description: Manage Beutl projects with Git. Media files are stored in Git LFS automatically.
emptyDescription: Create your first repository to start versioning your Beutl projects.
createDescription: Create a repository for a Beutl project. It is private and visible only to you.
name: Name
emptyRepositoryDescription: Push from Beutl and your files will show up here.
fileTooLarge: File is too large to display.
renameDescription: Renaming changes the clone URL. Existing clones need their remote URL updated.
deleteDescription: This deletes the repository, its history, and everything stored in LFS. It cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm: Type the repository name {{name}} to confirm.
credentialsDescription: Use this as the password when cloning or pushing from Beutl or the command line. Issue one per device.
credentialIssued: It will not be shown again once you leave this page. Tokens on your other devices keep working.

errors.notConfigured: The Git service is not configured. Please contact an administrator.
errors.nameInvalid: Only letters, digits, and - _ . are allowed.
errors.nameTaken: A repository with that name already exists.
errors.unknown: The operation failed. Please try again later.
errors.labelTaken: That device name is already in use.
errors.credentialLimit: You can hold at most {{limit}} tokens. Revoke one you no longer use.

deviceLabelHint: A name to tell your devices apart later. Up to 50 characters.
